// Scheduled fixed comparison; invoke only inside the sole limiter-owned driver.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { cpus, platform, arch } from 'node:os';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
const [configuration, output] = process.argv.slice(2);
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(configuration, 'utf8'));
const modules = {};
for (const [label, variant] of Object.entries(config.variants))
  modules[label] = await import(pathToFileURL(variant.directory + '/packages/cil/src/index.js'));
const bytes = readFileSync(config.variants.after.directory + '/tests/fixtures/portable-pdb-local-constants/LocalConstants.dll');
const hash = bytes => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
const serialize = value => JSON.stringify(value, (_, entry) => typeof entry === 'bigint' ? { bigint: String(entry) } : entry);
const inspectors = {}, observations = {};
for (const [label, { AssemblyInspector }] of Object.entries(modules)) {
  inspectors[label] = new AssemblyInspector(bytes);
  const summary = inspectors[label].summary();
  observations[label] = { methodCount: summary.methods.length, typeCount: summary.types.length,
    summarySha256: hash(serialize(summary)), cachedMethods: inspectors[label].cache.size };
}
assert.deepEqual(inspectors.before.summary(), inspectors.after.summary(), 'Legacy summary control must remain identical');
const chronologicalSamples = [], summaries = {};
const startedAt = new Date().toISOString(), start = performance.now();
const report = { config, node: process.version, host: `${platform()} ${arch()} ${cpus()[0].model}`, startedAt,
  protocol: { pairsPerControl: 20, coldWarmups: 30, warmWarmups: 100, coldIterations: 100, warmIterations: 500,
    order: 'AB/BA alternating', gcBeforeEachSample: true, median: 'mean of positions 10 and 11', p95: 'nearest-rank position 19',
    qualification: 'One fixed shared-host schedule; all chronological samples retained, no retries/exclusion, no causal noise/significance/peak allocation claim.' },
  fixture: { bytes: bytes.length, sha256: hash(bytes), harnessSha256: hash(readFileSync(new URL(import.meta.url))) },
  observations, summaries, chronologicalSamples };
try {
  for (const [control, iterations, warmups] of [['coldSummary', 100, 30], ['cachedSummary', 500, 100]]) {
    const actions = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(modules).map(([label, { AssemblyInspector }]) => [label,
      control === 'coldSummary' ? () => new AssemblyInspector(bytes).summary().methods.length
        : () => inspectors[label].summary().methods.length]));
    for (let warmup = 0; warmup < warmups; warmup++) { actions.before(); actions.after(); }
    for (let pair = 0; pair < 20; pair++) for (const label of pair % 2 === 0 ? ['before', 'after'] : ['after', 'before']) {
      globalThis.gc?.();
      let observed;
      const sampleStart = performance.now();
      for (let iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; iteration++) observed = actions[label]();
      const elapsedMs = performance.now() - sampleStart;
      assert.equal(observed, observations[label].methodCount);
      chronologicalSamples.push({ control, pair, label, startOffsetMs: sampleStart - start, elapsedMs, perOperationMs: elapsedMs / iterations });
    }
    summaries[control] = {};
    for (const label of ['before', 'after']) {
      const values = chronologicalSamples.filter(sample => sample.control === control && sample.label === label)
        .map(sample => sample.perOperationMs).sort((a, b) => a - b);
      summaries[control][label] = { medianMs: (values[9] + values[10]) / 2, p95Ms: values[18] };
    }
  }
  report.passed = true;
} catch (error) {
  report.passed = false;
  report.error = { name: error.name, message: error.message };
  throw error;
} finally {
  writeFileSync(output, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2) + '\n');
}
console.log(JSON.stringify({ output, summaries }, null, 2));
